collectReadiness.noPersistedSession: No persisted session on the proxy for collection. Use «Web login» on the same provider endpoint.
collectReadiness.authPending: Web login still in progress in proxy Chromium. Close the browser flow or wait; collection runs only after the login window closes.
collectReadiness.browserUnavailable: Chromium busy or profile in use. Close any proxy login window; if it persists, kill google-chrome/chromium processes and restart the proxy (pnpm dev). Then use «Check status».
collectReadiness.authRequired: Session listed on proxy (account {{accountId}}), but collection returned authentication_required. Repeat login or check SESSION_STORAGE_PATH on the proxy.
collectReadiness.collectionFailed: Collection failed on proxy (collection_failed). Close extra Chromium instances, restart pnpm dev, and repeat login.
collectReadiness.challengeRequired: Login or collection blocked in proxy browser (Google/x.ai or automation detection). Use GitHub or email on login, finish at cursor.com/dashboard or Agents, and avoid Google. If it persists, close the login window and click «Check status» again.
collectReadiness.sessionExpired: Session stored on proxy (touched: {{touchedAt}}), but collection at grok.com/dashboard failed (session_expired). After login, wait for the usage dashboard to open or repeat «Web login» until you see the usage panel in proxy Chromium.
collectReadiness.timeout: Proxy collection timed out. Try «Check status» or «Web login» again.
collectReadiness.probeBlocked: Proxy session: authenticated; collection: {{status}}. Quotas cannot refresh until the probe returns available.
collectReadiness.ready: Collection ready on proxy (account {{accountId}}). Last touched: {{touchedAt}}. Use Refresh on Quotas.

authStart.headless: Login started on proxy in headless mode (common in Docker): no Chrome window opens on your machine. Google/GitHub login requires proxy on the host: stop Docker on port 9090, run `pnpm dev:proxy` (or `pnpm --dir apps/proxy dev`) with CURSOR_USAGE_AUTH_HEADLESS=false and repeat Web login. Reference: {{link}}
authStart.headed: Login started. Use the «Sign in — Google Chrome» window the proxy opened (email/password or Google/GitHub). Do not use another browser tab — status updates here automatically. Instructions: {{link}}

admin.unavailable: Provider administration is unavailable. Enable PostgreSQL persistence and ensure the admin API is reachable.

patchMessages.clearSessionsSuccess: {{detail}}ACP sessions and gateway cache were cleared. «Check OAuth status» may still show authenticated while the proxy host has Google tokens on disk (e.g. ~/.gemini) — revoke/remove them on the proxy server to fully end OAuth.{{warnings}}
patchMessages.clearSessionsFail: Failed to clear sessions on the proxy. Check endpoint, Gateway API Key, and proxy reachability.
patchMessages.webLoginDoneProbeFail: Web login completed (session {{sessionId}}), but could not confirm persistence/collection on the proxy.
patchMessages.clearCursorSessionsSuccess: Cursor collector sessions cleared on proxy (namespace: {{namespace}}). A new web login is required to collect usage.
patchMessages.clearCursorSessionsFail: Failed to clear cursor-usage sessions on the proxy. Check endpoint and Gateway API Key.
patchMessages.noActiveSession: No active login session in this modal and nothing persisted on the proxy for collection. Use «Web login» (same proxy as the endpoint, e.g. Docker or pnpm dev).
patchMessages.webLoginProbeFail: Web login (operation) authenticated, but failed to probe collection on the proxy.
patchMessages.webLoginOpStatus: Web login (operation): {{status}}. Proxy account: {{accountId}}. Expires at {{expiresAt}}.
patchMessages.statusProbeFail: Failed to query status on the proxy. Check endpoint and Gateway API Key.
patchMessages.gatewayKeyRequired: Enter the proxy Gateway API Key (field above) before starting web login.
patchMessages.oauthStatusFail: Failed to query OAuth status on the proxy. Check endpoint and Gateway API Key.
patchMessages.oauthPopupBlocked: OAuth flow started. The browser blocked a new tab; copy and open the link: {{url}}
patchMessages.oauthOpened: OAuth flow opened in a new tab. After finishing on Google, use "Check OAuth status" to confirm.
patchMessages.oauthStartFail: Failed to start OAuth on the proxy. Check endpoint and Gateway API Key.
patchMessages.testAntigravitySuccess: Gateway reachable and operational (model list test). This does not verify whether the Antigravity/ACP context was ended.
patchMessages.testConnectionSuccess: Connection tested successfully! The provider is reachable and operational.
patchMessages.testConnectionFail: Connection test failed. Check the credential and endpoint.
patchMessages.preSaveTestFail: Provider connection test failed. Credential rejected.
